risks.risk: Wrong transmission variant/fitment for the buyer’s exact Ford Fusion setup (different codes/variants can look similar).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the transmission ID/label with readable part number (and/or casting number) plus the donor VIN/engine code and transmission code.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: may not fit or may require extra parts/adjustments.

risks.risk: Working status not proven remotely (could fail under load or have intermittent faults).
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested (engagement through gears) and/or a diagnostic scan report showing no transmission-related fault codes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: treated like not proven working.

risks.risk: Leaks or damage not visible in these angles (seals, gaskets, cooler line fittings, cracks).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seals/gaskets and underside mounting areas, plus any wetness/staining around fittings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: may leak and may need resealing.

risks.proof: Photo inventory showing what is included (sensors, solenoids, harness connectors, cooler lines, brackets) and what is excluded.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: may be missing parts required for installation.

proof_requests: Send a new clear close-up photo of the transmission label/plate with readable part number (photo 0/1/2 label area, but sharper).
Send the transmission code and confirm automatic/manual.
Send a short video of the test (engagement through gears) or a diagnostic scan report with no transmission fault codes.
Send close-ups of all seals/gaskets and any cooler line fittings/areas for leaks.
Confirm included/excluded parts with photos (sensors/solenoids/harness connectors/mounting brackets).
response.reason: The seller’s insistence doesn’t replace missing evidence. Without readable identifiers and proof of testing/condition, the exact fitment and working status can’t be priced confidently, so proof is required first.
